reviewOutcome: A first-party Jiayuguan public geographic-information platform and local GeoServer WFS cadastral layer were verified with a bounded anonymous ID-plus-geometry response; runtime readiness remains held pending serial reviewer qualification.
queryAndRequestOutcomes: Separate English and Chinese discovery was completed. The official Jiayuguan Natural Resources Bureau identifies 天地图·嘉峪关 as the authoritative local map platform. Its public JavaScript/configuration exposed the local jygserver workspace. WMS and WFS capabilities were reachable; WFS DescribeFeatureType verified jygserver:zongdi (宗地), EPSG:4326 geometry, and native identity fields. A bounded WFS GetFeature request returned 3 of 3831 matched features, from which a safe three-polygon sample retaining only feature IDs and geometry was written.
cityOrLocalCustodian: 嘉峪关市自然资源局 (Jiayuguan Natural Resources Bureau) and its 天地图·嘉峪关 geographic-information public-service platform are evidenced as the local custodian/platform. General national agency prose was not used as local source evidence.
scopeLimits: No citywide completeness or legal/public-use admission claim.
No exact-point absence inference; WUP point remains exactly [39.7930141031446,98.2707265971408].
Only 3 full parcel polygons were retained; source attributes were not retained.
No credentials, private tokens, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, or TLS verification disablement was used.
uncertainty: Independent serial review is still needed for adapter qualification, identity semantics, service stability, update cadence, and runtime policy; the successful public response alone does not admit the source.
integrationDisposition: Research packet only; no registry/catalog/runtime files changed.
